title: Implement group log append and article number assignment on POST
description:
For each group in Newsgroups:, append a LogEntry (hlc_timestamp, article_cid, operator_signature) to that group's log. Assign a local article number in each group. Update the group's low/high range. Artifact: reader/src/post/log_append.rs.

Acceptance:
- Multi-group post appends to all listed groups
- Article number assigned in each group is monotonically increasing
- Log append failure (e.g. unknown group) returns 441 and rolls back IPFS write
- Unit test: post to 3 groups, verify log entries and article numbers in all three
